# Elite Logistix

Elite Logistix is a Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage company. Elite Logistix is a logistics company that provides shipping and supply chain management solutions. Elite Logistix employs 25 people (+25.0% YoY, +5 people), founded in 2007. Headquartered in Rock Hill, South Carolina, United States, with an office in Mobile.

## About

Elite Logistix is a provider of 3rd Party Logistic Services, such as Warehousing, Distribution, Fulfillment, Kitting, Sequencing, Cross-Docking and Transportation services. Elite currently operates Logistics Facilities totaling 325,000sf (and growing).

Our Corporate Offices are located in Rock Hill, SC 

ROCK HILL, SC (Commerce Drive)
Elite operates a 325,000sf, multi-client distribution complex in Rock Hill, SC, just 15 miles South of Charlotte, NC. Our complex in Rock Hill, is a mixed use complex, comprised of Dedicated Logistics and Public Warehousing Clients, servicing manufacturing and distribution channels. In this operation we provide a wide array of logistics and transportation services.

ROCK HILL, SC (Legacy Park)
Legacy Park is a 126,000sf Multi-Client Facility, offering specialized Pick/Pack and Distribution operations.

# Elite Logistics

Elite Logistics is a Wholesale Import and Export company. Elite Logistics provides systems and solutions to maximize the performance of supply chains and businesses. Elite Logistics employs 25 people (+92.3% YoY, +12 people), founded in 2003. Headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, United States, with an office in Rock Hill.
